cat.title: Saint Peter's Undergraduate Catalog - Admissions Information (test-optional policy, international deadlines)

test_policy.notes: First-year applicants may choose not to submit SAT/ACT. Scores are still required for candidates for high merit scholarships, pre-professional joint programs and home-schooled students unless waived. Scores that are submitted are also used for placement.

requirements.notes: Apply with the Common Application or the Saint Peter's International Student Application (PDF). No application fee (international FAQ). Required: transcripts with English translation sent directly from the school or an EducationUSA advisor, one recommendation, a short essay/personal statement, proof of English proficiency, plus I-20 financial support statement and passport copy. $150 non-refundable tuition deposit after admission. Decisions are typically within 2-3 weeks of a complete file (FAQ and catalog).

deadlines.label: International fall application deadline (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: International FAQ: June 1 for fall and November 1 for spring. The undergraduate catalog instead says August 1 for fall (one month before the term), so the pages disagree; the page prints no year, so fall 2027 is assumed. Late applications may be considered as time permits; applying at least three months ahead is recommended.

deadlines.label: Catalog international fall deadline (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Undergraduate catalog date; conflicts with the June 1 date on the international FAQ. Confirm with intadmission@saintpeters.edu.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Students whose native language is not English must submit one approved English test sent directly from the testing agency. In lieu of TOEFL/IELTS, SAT EBRW 510+ or ACT English and Writing 19+ in each section is accepted (the catalog still says SAT Critical Reading 450+, so the pages differ). Also accepted: ELS course completion with score 112, Kaplan Advanced Level, FLS level 15. TOEFL may be waived by the Dean of International Enrollment; the FAQ says citizens of Canada, Australia, Ireland, New Zealand and the UK may be exempt. No conditional-admission or on-campus ESL pathway is described.

english.notes: Exams taken on or after January 21, 2026; the page prints "4" without naming the scale (presumably the new 1-6 scale).
Pearson PTE Academic or Pearson Express test.
The page and FAQ say IELTS scores are accepted (sent directly by the British Council, IDP or Cambridge) but print no minimum score.

aid.notes: FAQ: international undergraduates are eligible for scholarships (up to 4 years or 120 credits) based on school marks and test scores, but there are no full scholarships for international students; the Dean of International Enrollment holds the current list. The freshman merit table (awarded at admission by GPA: $20,000 to $30,000 a year, Presidential full tuition) is not labeled domestic-only, but the page does not say it applies to international students, so confirm. Need-based aid for internationals is not described.

ielts.note: No code listed; the testing body sends results directly.

tier_notes.general: Our estimate: small Jesuit regional university in Jersey City (near Manhattan) offering 50+ majors including business, nursing, biology and computer science; no nationally ranked programs found, so general and subject tiers are D.
